desc: The Kimber Liberty Custom LW 1911 Semi-Auto Pistol takes the classic design of the 1911 and sheds its extra bulk. Its lightweight machined-aluminum frame with a KIMPRO finish offers comfortable carry that won't weigh you down, while its stainless steel match-grade barrel delivers reliable accuracy again and again. 3-hole skeletonized trigger provides a crisp, satisfying pull. Textured ERGO grips create a rock-solid hold for increased control. Iron sights help you stay on target. Also equipped with a lowered, flared ejection port and beveled magwell.
